cohort: The study included 101 COVID-19 positive pregnant women from a tertiary care center.
finding: No worsening of maternal and neonatal outcomes were observed due to COVID-19 infection.
mod_finding: 70.3% of pregnant women had cesarean deliveries, primarily attributed to oligohydramnios.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy and at the time of delivery, utilizing case records.
gest_age: 36.03 +/- 6.66 weeks (mean gestational age for becoming COVID positive)
